svg.aria-label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash CSA2: candidate blocks and causal sparse indices schematic
svg.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash — CSA2: candidate blocks and causal sparse indices
svg.desc: The candidate producer scores blocks by their best position and keeps the newest reachable block. Reindex layers mask their position scores to that pool; reuse layers consume the resulting indices. Authored adaptation of DeepSeek publisher code (MIT). Query and index keys are already projected and rotated. FP4 quantization, distributed reduction and cache publication are omitted. visible is the completed-group count floor((query_position + 1) / ratio), shaped [B,T,1]. The candidate budget must cover the requested sparse selection; unavailable picks are represented by -1. Publisher mapping is not production certification.
